criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the mintedAmount parameter, where it is added to the owner's balance without a check, allowing the owner to set the total supply arbitrarily high.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the amount parameter, where it is multiplied by sellPrice without a check, allowing attackers to overflow the amount variable and cause a crash in the exchange.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the msg.value, where it is divided by buyPrice without a check, allowing attackers to overflow the msg.value variable and cause a crash in the exchange.

The deposit function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The vulnerability resides in the msg.value, where it is added to the contract balance without a check, allowing attackers to overflow the contract balance and cause a crash in the exchange.
